name: Lam Lam
source:
"I", as the protagonist, is a freelance illustrator who works hard every day. Because of some previous experiences "I" are not keen on communicating with others. Therefore, "I" chose to stay at home all day, avoiding any socialization and annoying situations. One night, "I" noticed that the neighbor's Room F was making some noise as usual. Just at this moment, I heard the cry of a girl from Room F. "I" was curious about what was going on, so "I" used my superpowers to see what was going on next door. What awaits the "me" will be a heinous and heartbreaking scene. What should the "me" do...  

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我”作为主角，是一名每天努力工作的自由插画师。由于之前的一些经历，“我”不热衷于与他人交流。因此，“我”选择整天呆在家里，避免任何社交和烦人的情况。一天晚上，“我”注意到邻居的F房像往常一样发出一些噪音。就在这时，听到F室里传来女孩的哭声，“我”很好奇到底发生了什么，于是就用超能力去看看隔壁到底发生了什么。等待“我”的将是令人发指、心碎的一幕。“我”该怎么办…  

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169800/]Steam[/url]]
